headline: CFPB Orders Wells Fargo to Pay $3.7 Billion for Widespread Mismanagement
summary: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau ordered Wells Fargo to pay billions in customer redress and penalties for illegal fees and loan mismanagement.

headline: Wells Fargo Announces Routine Quarterly Dividend
summary: Wells Fargo declared a quarterly dividend of $0.35 per share payable next month.

headline: Equifax Faces Multistate Attorney General Inquiry Over Credit File Inaccuracies
summary: State attorneys general opened a joint probe into algorithmic errors in Equifax consumer reports causing incorrect loan denials.

headline: Equifax Reports Quarterly Cybersecurity Audit Completion
summary: Independent third-party verification confirmed compliance with multi-state security remediation mandates.

headline: PayPal Resolves Intermittent Payment Processing Gateway Latency
summary: PayPal stated that an infrastructure failure in its checkout authorization engine had been resolved after affecting merchant transactions.

headline: CFPB Inquires Into PayPal Digital Wallet User Funds Holds
summary: Regulators sought documentation regarding consumer complaints on account freezes and prolonged settlement holds.

headline: SEC Files Civil Lawsuit Against Coinbase Citing Unregistered Securities Exchange Operations
summary: The SEC filed a major civil lawsuit in federal court alleging Coinbase operated an unregistered securities exchange and broker-dealer.

headline: Coinbase Resolves Service Disruption on Web and Mobile Trading Platforms
summary: Platform operational status confirmed full recovery of order matching engines after 3 hours of elevated traffic latency.

headline: Navient Agrees to Nationwide Settlement Over Student Loan Servicing Practices
summary: Navient reached a comprehensive settlement with federal and state regulators regarding forbearance steering allegations.

headline: Department of Education Audits Navient Special Direct Loan Portfolios
summary: Federal compliance auditors initiate comprehensive review of borrower forgiveness credit accounting records.
